record.question: Which country has launched the world's first AI-powered bank called Ryt Bank?
record.explanation: Answer B: Malaysia. Ryt Bank is a Malaysian digital bank and was launched by YTL Digital Bank Berhad. The first-AI-powered description is the bank/operator’s launch claim, not an independently established universal technology priority. Reference: https://www.rytbank.my/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
